title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Miovision:

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

  • All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

  • One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

  • Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

  • Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

  • Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

Position Summary:

At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, but to keep our app business moving at top speed, we need a highly strategic Senior Product Manager to take the wheel. Reporting directly to the Product Director of App Services, you will navigate the complex intersections of our detection, performance, and traffic optimization portfolio. We are looking for someone who can see through the fog of domain ambiguity, mapping out a clear route that transforms vague market needs and intangible user behaviors into concrete solutions. You will be the driver shaping our industry—shifting our products out of the slow lane of basic data visualization and accelerating into automated optimization. If you are ready to steer our software and hardware ecosystem to solve real-world infrastructure challenges without hitting a gridlock, green means go!

Objectives and Responsibilities:

  • Own the Strategy: Take full accountability for the success and adoption metrics of your product area, looking beyond immediate feature sets to define how our software and hardware seamlessly integrate.

  • See the Future: Predict 1-2 year industry shifts, initiate de-risking projects today, and distill massive market complexity into a crystal-clear "North Star" for your team.

  • Master the Economics: Proactively design solutions that address the "cost of scale." Pivot strategies to drastically reduce deployment friction and improve unit economics across your entire product line.

  • Turn Ambiguity into Action: Take ill-defined problems within the detection and optimization space, evaluate highly variable factors, and guide them toward compelling, actionable solutions with high-conviction business cases backed by a robust 12-month roadmap.

  • Establish Discovery Rhythms: Build a permanent rhythm of discovery to inform your long-term plans. Ensure your team builds with absolute conviction by validating the "riskiest assumptions" first.

  • Leverage AI & Data: Define exactly how AI and complex data insights can transform the user experience, transitioning our offerings from reactive data visualization to automated, predictive optimization.

  • Make High-Stakes Decisions: Spearhead major innovations, architectures, and key business decisions where the consequence of error is severe. Direct product investments based on a deep understanding of market-wide economic trends and P&L goals.

  • Shift the Culture: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and play a pivotal role in shifting the organization toward a culture that is inherently Product-Led and Sales-Supported.

  • Align and Mentor: Build formal networks with key industry executives. Successfully align Sales, Engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams on unified release plans for high-stakes projects, while serving as a central hub for cross-discipline coordination and a go-to mentor for junior PMs.

Technical Portfolio Overview:

  • Driving the software experiences that interpret multi-modal sensing data and evaluate traffic and infrastructure performance.

  • Developing adaptive applications and tools that respond to real-time traffic conditions.

  • Ensuring your products integrate seamlessly with our overarching platform ecosystem and respect the integrity of the broader architecture.

The Ideal Profile:

  • The Seasoned Pro: You exhibit advanced, wide-ranging experience and are highly comfortable navigating the ambiguity, autonomy, and rigorous standards expected at top-tier tech organizations.

  • User-Obsessed: You always start with the user and work backwards. You build continuous discovery loops to deeply understand user pain points, validating your assumptions with multi-modal data before committing a single engineering resource.

  • Business-Minded: You understand that your product does not exist in a vacuum. You possess sharp business acumen, deeply understanding financial levers (like COGS and margins) and exactly how your product ties into broader engineering and sales goals.

  • The Complex Problem Solver: You excel at breaking down highly complex issues, evaluating variable factors, and delivering creative, highly effective solutions to the market.

  • The Strategic Diplomat: You excel at managing "up and sideways." You know exactly how to say "no" strategically, offering data-driven alternatives that protect your team from distractions while ensuring critical business needs are met.

Your Rewards & Well-being:
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

  • Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

  • Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

  • Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

  • Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
